evidence_note: v1 remains the headline. v2 was chosen after the result was known and is sensitivity-only.

market_classification.definition: eventual outcome >= 0.90 at the first minute at/after official poll close and never below 0.80 afterwards

mix.label: tau mixture over earlier nights (chosen after the result was known)
mix.note: An equal-weight mixture over the reporting-order errors that 7 earlier count nights needed (mx2012 0.015, mx2018 0.02, br2022r1 0, br2022r2 0.005, mx2024 0.03, pl2025r1 0.0075, pl2025r2 0.02). Same point forecast as the base model (rho 0.8, kappa 50,000); only the band and the win chance allow for those 7 different errors instead of one. Built from earlier nights only, but chosen after this result was known, so it is a sensitivity, not a forecast.

v2.label: v2: settings from 2014, 2018 and 2022 (chosen after the result was known)
